about: The course follows the Pinyin chart. Each lesson teaches one or more chart entries (a final with a group of initials, e.g. a:bpmf = ba pa ma fa) and may introduce tones. A lesson's words may only use syllables and tones taught up to and including that lesson; tools/build.py checks this. Lessons with a data/<id>.json file are built; the others are planned, and their 'words' are candidates.
